description: Límites Marítimos del Reino de España (INSPIRE) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by centrodedescargas.cnig.es. Maritime limits published in official documents (BOE, Royal Decrees, Agreements,...) of the Kingdom of Spain including: Drawing of straight baselines under Law 20/1967 of 8 April 1967 on the extension of Spanish waters to 12 miles for fishing purposes (Royal Decree 2510/1977, ‘BOE’ No. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Maritime limits of the Kingdom of Spain (INSPIRE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2019-02-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
